import os, pty, subprocess, time, select, sys, threading

def main():
    m, s = pty.openpty()
    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        ['./emulator.sh', 'cmake_out/vela_goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/'],
        stdin=s, stdout=s, stderr=s, close_fds=True
    )
    os.close(s)

    # Wait for NSH
    print('Booting emulator...', flush=True)
    buf = b''
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < 90:
        r, _, _ = select.select([m], [], [], 0.5)
        if r:
            try:
                data = os.read(m, 4096)
                buf += data
                if b'goldfish-armv8a-ap>' in buf:
                    print('NSH ready!', flush=True)
                    break
            except OSError:
                time.sleep(0.5)
        time.sleep(0.1)

    if b'goldfish-armv8a-ap>' not in buf:
        print('Timeout', flush=True)
        proc.terminate()
        sys.exit(1)

    time.sleep(1)
    os.write(m, b'phywear\n')
    print('phywear launched, waiting for UI...', flush=True)
    time.sleep(5)

    # Take screenshot via emulator console
    import socket
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.connect(('127.0.0.1', 5554))
    sock.settimeout(5)
    time.sleep(1)
    sock.recv(4096)
    sock.send(b'auth g1P+1/2gx7PaFfUI\r\n')
    time.sleep(1)
    sock.recv(4096)

    # Try screendump
    sock.send(b'screenrecord screenshot /tmp/phywear_screenshot.png\r\n')
    time.sleep(1)
    resp = sock.recv(4096)
    print('Screenshot resp:', resp.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))

    sock.close()
    print('Emulator PID:', proc.pid, flush=True)
    # Keep running
    with open('/tmp/phywear_emulator.pid', 'w') as f:
        f.write(str(proc.pid))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
